_about: Public-domain Henri-Dominique Lacordaire (1802-1861, Dominican preacher of Notre Dame) in English for the Word Hoard: the Conferences at Notre Dame tr. Henry Langdon (London, 1853), the Notre Dame conferences Jesus Christ (1869), God (1870) and God and Man (catalogued 1872) translated by a Tertiary of the Order, Life: Conferences at Toulouse tr. Henry D. Langdon (1873), the Letters to Young Men tr. James Trenor (Baltimore, 1871), and his Life of Saint Dominic tr. Mrs. Edward Hazeland (1883), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
